summary: Port is probed, released, then bound -- a TOCTOU window.
true_fix: Do not probe and release. Bind the real socket to port 0 and keep it, reading the assigned port from `getsockname()`.
nondeterminism_source: Two services scan the same fixed range concurrently. Each closes its probe before binding, so both can see the same port free and race to claim it.
masking_fix: Retry the bind on EADDRINUSE, or widen the scan range so collisions get rarer without becoming impossible.
